programs.title: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Ep.1
programs.desc: Explore the Greater Bay Area through a global perspective, tracing its history of cooperation, ongoing development and lessons from leading bay-area economies around the world. Discover what drives the region’s role in China’s development.

programs.title: Memories of a Snub-nosed Monkey in the Qinling Mountains
programs.desc: Golden snub-nosed monkeys offer a window into some of China’s latest ecological research, highlighting the nation's progress and vision for human-nature harmony.

programs.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic
programs.desc: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.

programs.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 1
programs.desc: Nanjing, an ancient city that served as the capital of six imperial dynasties, stands as a testament to China's long-standing history and rich culture. From its Porcelain Tower - one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages, to its grand city walls and ancient palaces, join us on a voyage across time to experience the echoes of history in Nanjing's storied bricks.

programs.title: Grottoes of China Ep.1
programs.desc: China's grottoes are a stage for exchange among peoples and a vital vehicle for cultural dialogue. Through the work of grotto-art protectors, researchers and communicators, these sites have endured as treasures of Chinese civilization for generations.
